_description: Shared post-processing cases for the TFLite output tensor (ADR-006, T33). Python (src/common/postprocess.py) and Dart (mobile/lib/services/classifier_postprocess.dart) must agree digit for digit: the app and the reported metrics have to describe the same model.
_rules: Integer output is dequantised with the tensor's own (scale, zero_point).
Scores are renormalised by their sum. Softmax is never applied to values that are already probabilities.
A degenerate output (all zero, or a non-positive sum) is reported as an even split, not as a confident class.

cases.name: int8 output with a non-zero zero point
int8 scores that do not already sum to one
float output that already sums to one is left alone
float logits-shaped output is renormalised, never softmaxed
a degenerate all-zero output is an even split, not a confident call
